title: Counting-sort key expression
statement: The key expression is the memory access at the address obtained by adding the offset to the product of the stride and the memory access at the sum of the source and index variables, then adding the keys variable.
caveat: The formal snippet does not include definitions of the expression constructors or arithmetic notation, so the intended interpretation of the address expression is uncertain.
